name: Ms. Marvel (Kamala Khan)

abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.

signatureAbility:
Morphogenetics
Ms. Marvel starts to figure out this whole Contest thing, increasing her Fury durations by [2 - 8] seconds and increasing the Potency of her Fury effects by 10%.

abilitySections.title: Passive
content: As the inexperienced Ms. Marvel gets to know her opponent's fighting style, she better learns to alter her size and avoid incoming damage, increasing Block Proficiency by [143.62] for each Fury effect she has active.
An enhanced immune system provides full Immunity to Poison.

abilitySections.title: Special Attacks
content: While Ms. Marvel has 3 or more stacks of Fury, her Special Attacks Nullify 2 stacks of her opponent's Buffs.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: While charging her Heavy Attack, Ms. Marvel continually gains stacks of Fury to a max of 3, each increasing her Attack by [873.18] for 10 seconds. These stacks are lost as she is struck during combat.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: This attack triggers up to 4 stacks of Fury, each increasing Attack by [665.28] for 9 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: 100% chance to gain a Fury Buff for 10 seconds, granting +[1,580.04] Attack.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: This attack has a 90% chance to grant a permanent Fury effect, increasing Attack by [1,580.04].

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Morphogenetics
content: Ms. Marvel starts to figure out this whole Contest thing, increasing her Fury durations by [2 - 8] seconds and increasing the Potency of her Fury effects by 10%.
